page.title: Surfaced elsewhere — a cross-reference index
page.subtitle: Documents from the DOJ Epstein release (EFTA) that came to attention because they were surfaced and circulated publicly — not located here through a search term or a statistical pass. One representative line is quoted from each; click the document id to read it in full and open the original scan. The quote is verbatim from the file named on the card.
page.explainer: A launch pad. These are documents other people pointed at; this index records where each sits in the files (bates id + dataset), quotes a line so it can speak for itself, and links the primary so it can be read in full and cross-referenced against the rest of the corpus. The document id opens the text in the side panel with a link to the original DOJ scan, redactions intact.
